summary.text: Frank Roberts is a Republican candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary.
He also ran for the seat in 2024 and lost the general election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Roberts as a withdrawn or disqualified Republican candidate in the 2022 race for Arizona House District 26.

In the November 5, 2024 general election, he received 17.1 percent of the vote (14,359 votes), finishing behind Democratic incumbents Cesar Aguilar and Quantá Crews and ahead of Republican Skyla Edwards.
